text_simplified: The text speaks of the virtue of tarbiyah (upbringing) of daughters and the great reward for those who support them and treat them with ihsan (excellence). It mentions Prophetic hadiths that encourage patience in their tarbiyah and spending on them. It also clarifies that whoever has three daughters or three sisters and treats them with excellence will enter Paradise. It emphasizes that the tarbiyah of daughters requires patience and seeking reward from Allah.
